title: ElevenLabs Scribe transcription helper
what_it_does: Sends audio to ElevenLabs speech-to-text and writes a word-level JSON beside the input.
when_to_use: Only for someone who already pays for ElevenLabs.
why: Paid cloud API and the audio leaves the machine; we offer local whisper.cpp first. The word-JSON shape it writes is worth supporting as an input.
